amendment_v2.change: trainer gains --width/--spectral-rank CLI knobs (previously hardcoded); width-64 default path byte-equivalent

bindings.trainer_capacity_args_amendment: trainer needs --width/--spectral-rank CLI knobs (currently hardcoded 64/32); added as infra-only amendment with new sha before launch

budget.abort_rule: abort a lane on NaN, or if epoch-1 wall time projects >16h for that lane
budget.artifact_policy: best.pt + metrics.jsonl + terminal.json per lane; width-128 best.pt ~7MB, negligible
budget.estimated_hours: armA ~3.9h (77s/ep x 180), armB ~8-10h (width128 ~2-2.5x step cost); all lanes parallel so wall clock ~10h

design.arm_A_budget: width=64, spectral_rank=32, modes=24, depth=4, epochs=180 (fresh cosine to 1e-5*lr); FROM SCRATCH (not resumed from v2 best) so the cosine schedule is clean and the v2 lanes remain an untouched judged artifact
design.arm_B_capacity: identical to arm A except width=128, spectral_rank=64; micro_records may drop to 2 if 24G VRAM requires (infra knob, recorded in run_identity)
design.fixed: ic8 only (v2 gate B winner); manifest, windows, loss, optimizer family, grad clip, gate-fix (frozen unit gate + zero-init 3x3 decode head), FrameConditionedPropagator all byte-identical to v2 amendment_v3
design.grid: 2 arms x 2 seeds (372, 733), one lane per GPU, 4 GPUs
design.ic2_note: ic2 is NOT rerun; v2 already established ic8 > ic2 under the frozen gate B

evidence_boundary: development 90-record subset only; validation full-split and test_id stay sealed

judgement_frozen.failure_signal: gate C fails on both arms' evidence: the v2 number stands as the line's plateau; next lever is tail/worst-record structure, not more training
judgement_frozen.gate_C_budget_recovers: arm A counts as recovering real trajectory iff BOTH its seeds' best < 0.11629 (v2 ic8 mean - v2 seed band); otherwise the ep60 slope was terminal-phase cosine artifact
judgement_frozen.gate_D_capacity_beats_budget: arm B counts as beating pure budget iff |mean(B) - mean(A)| > max(armA_band, armB_band) AND B < A on both seed pairings
judgement_frozen.no_post_hoc_extension: 180 epochs per lane; no extension without a new preregistration
judgement_frozen.primary_metric: best-over-epochs eval-window aggregate (frames 8..63, 90 records), per lane
judgement_frozen.secondary_watch_not_gated: per-record max (v2 froze at 0.503): report it, do not gate on it

motivation: v2 judged (results/b2_snapshot_ic_v2_decision_report_20260831.md): gate A+B both PASS, ic8 is the winning arm (-6.9% vs warp anchor), and ALL four lanes peaked at ep60 (best==last epoch) with a live ep50-60 slope of -3.6e-5/ep on both ic8 seeds -- the 60ep budget truncated an undissipated trajectory. Per no_post_hoc_extension, continuation requires this new preregistration. The two cheapest unpulled levers are budget (longer cosine) and capacity (width). One factor per arm, both on the frozen ic8 recipe.
question: On the frozen 90-record subset with 8-frame true-snapshot IC, how much of the remaining trajectory does (a) a 3x budget at fixed width-64, and (b) the same 3x budget at width-128, each recover; and does capacity beat pure budget beyond the seed noise band?
rollback: additive; v2 lanes and all prior checkpoints untouched
